title: The submitted input exceeded the context
subtitle: Full-input estimate and recorded serving counters
caveats: Offline full-input estimates and provider serving counters describe different stages. Which input tokens were omitted was not recorded.
The 8,192 context is a configured study limit, not a documented hardware or model maximum. History content changed in the budgeted arm.
caption: Original input: 10,397 tokens offline; serving counters: 8,173 prompt + 19 reply = 8,192. The 2,224-token difference and exact under-cap calibration strongly support serving-side input truncation; omitted token IDs were not saved. Budgeted raw input matches at 3,303 offline/recorded, followed by 53 reply tokens. History content also changed; no repair tools ran.
